lines.text: Jesus says to store up treasures in heaven, not on earth, because your heart will be where your treasure is.
Jesus says the eye is the lamp of the body, and bad eyes fill the whole body with darkness.
Jesus says no one can serve two masters, and you cannot serve both God and fame.
Jesus says the Father feeds the birds, and not even David in all his glory was adorned like the lilies.
Jesus says to seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and not to worry about tomorrow.
